android.desc:
A nice kit for Flutter fans to get technology insight of the Flutter Apps on the market.

Help you find all Apps developed with Flutter on your device.
Help you find all packages used inside by these Flutter Apps.
Then you can click the package you are interested in and have a look at it in detail from https://pub.dev/.

Have fun with Flutter!

quotes.text:
> With web apps, it's easy – just scan HTML, deduce what framework is used, and add it to your showcase list. With Flutter mobile/desktop apps it's not possible.

Seems like it is: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fluttershark.fluttersharkapp

Flutter two finger scroll "bug" is gone.

I wouldn't say its unlikely they carried a patch for it, I just wrote a framework patch that I apply at build time in CI and locally.

I refuse to sideload arbitrary APKs, especially from bytedance. I feel bad because that is irrational, you did, and it'd be really helpful if I did and just did this myself, but, you should install FlutterShark and check: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fluttershark.fluttersharkapp&hl=en_US
